pages.text: Schedule the child action after a delay measured in game ticks. Normally, 20 ticks equal one second.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: Only the connected nodes contribute; this node adds no mana fee.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.15 + H(t) + C, for delay t in ticks and action cost C. No repeated waiting fee.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).
